arguments.value: This is an endorsement agreement dated August 24, 1995 between Kathy Ireland, Inc. (on behalf of Kathy Ireland), The Sterling/Winters Co., and Diplomat Ambassador Eyewear Group. It gives Diplomat a worldwide license to use Kathy Ireland’s name and likeness only for certain eyewear and optical products, including sunglasses, eyeglasses, readers, ophthalmic frames, and certain accessories, for the period from August 1, 1995 through January 30, 2000, unless terminated earlier under the agreement. Diplomat must pay royalties and minimum royalties, provide sales statements, maintain books and records, carry product liability insurance, and meet quality, labeling, distribution, and approval requirements. Kathy Ireland agrees to endorse the eyewear, make one personal appearance per license year at Vision Expo in New York, participate in up to two photo sessions and one product information/sales video per license year, and Diplomat pays the related expenses described in the agreement. Kathy Ireland, Inc. keeps ownership of Kathy Ireland’s name and goodwill, and the license is exclusive for sunglasses and eyeglasses/readers/frames but nonexclusive for other covered products. The agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California. An addendum later required Diplomat to comply with state and territorial labor and safety laws for any Kathy Ireland products it manufactures or subcontracts, and to comply with reasonable requests from Kathy Ireland, Inc. on labor and safety resolutions.
